observations.title: Three Cenozoic dimensions
observations.player_action: Explore Paleogene, Neogene and Pleistocene eras. Formations are biome-like regions within each dimension.
observations.outcome: Content scope is three dimensions, not two.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Начни путешествие по трём доисторическим эпохам.

observations.title: Find Methuselah temple
observations.player_action: Search jungle biomes for the Temple to Methuselah; explore its chambers to reach the boss.
observations.outcome: Entrance to the time-travel unlock path.

observations.title: Defeat Methuselah
observations.player_action: Defeat the Methuselah boss in the temple and collect its eye.
observations.outcome: Eye needed to activate a completed forgotten portal.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Победи Мафусаила и получи его глаз.

observations.title: Restore a forgotten portal
observations.player_action: Find a forgotten portal, make its four portal corners correspond to the same era and complete the archstone pillars; activate it with the Eye of Methuselah.
observations.outcome: Travel to the selected Cenozoic dimension.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Восстанови портал и впервые отправься в прошлое.

observations.review_note: Portal corner combinations and server travel criteria need installed-version runtime verification.

observations.title: Make dried peat fuel
observations.player_action: Mine peat in Paleogene/Neogene, craft a peat pie, place it for roughly 20 minutes and collect the dried peat pie.
observations.outcome: Fuel usable in furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Высуши торфяную лепёшку и используй её как топливо.

observations.title: Tame a Leptictidium
observations.player_action: In the Paleogene Messel Pit formation, use a seed pouch to tame a Leptictidium; shift-use a tamed one to trigger its digging behavior.
observations.outcome: Tamed creature unearths items with a documented two-minute cooldown.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Приручи лептиктидия и попроси его раскопать предмет.

observations.title: Craft manganese steel
observations.player_action: Acquire manganese from the Pleistocene and process it with raw iron and silicate into manganese steel blend; smelt to ingot.
observations.outcome: Material for cold-resistant armor and utility gear.

observations.title: Grow small Platypodium trees from seed pods
observations.player_action: Harvest Platypodium seed pods in the Neogene and place them on ground.
observations.outcome: Small trees provide convenient wood farming despite non-decaying native leaves.
conditions: Upstream/native documentation is evidence, not a verified JEM gameplay rule; installed configuration and JEM overrides may differ.
